title: 与史郎中钦听黄鹤楼上吹笛
author: 李白
prompt: Edit this exact Chinese ink-watercolor illustration, preserving composition, two poets listening, tower flutist, summer Yangtze river, boats, distant buildings, warm ivory xuan-paper texture and the broad lower blank area. Remove EVERY flowering branch, blossom, and floating petal across the image, including all lower corners. Replace the flowering growth by understated summer green foliage only. The poem's 五月落梅花 refers to the flute tune 梅花落 in the fifth lunar month, NOT literal falling plum blossoms. No flowers anywhere. Do not add text or symbols; retain the original beautiful muted painting style.
visualReview: 已逐图查看修改版：两位诗人凭栏听楼上笛声，江城远帆与夏日绿叶呼应；初稿把曲名梅花落画成实际梅花，现已去除花朵花瓣，下部留白清净。
